Vehicle identificator number on the Tiburon can be found on a metal plate riveted to the firewall on the drivers side
[[File:VIN location engine bay.png|thumb|VIN location engine bay]]

If you happened to possess a file containing a lot of VINs, and wanted to extract only the Tiburons, this grep should do it:<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">
grep -E "KMHH[MN]6.[BDF]"
</syntaxhighlight>It'll extract all passenger cars made by Hyundai (KMH), from the Tiburon line (H - this should be enough in itself, but Genesis Coupe inherited that identifier), with Middle-Low/Middle configurations ([MN]), coupe body type (6) and 1.6/2.0/2.7 engines ([BDF])
